name: Peter Pan
source:
The king of Netherland, Peter Pan was once known for his exuberant playfulness and child-like innocence, but when his magic starts to die, so does the child within him.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Isle_of_Enchantment]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
